label: Phase 0 Hardware Classifier
description: Mandatory entry point for any hardware build. Captures the user's intent, identifies the target hardware family + variant, classifies path (Diagnose / Maintain / Develop) and tier (1 Personal / 2 Professional / 3 Market-placed). Produces the classification record that gates every downstream module.

claudeKnowledge.description: Hardware family registry, regulatory tier criteria (CRA, RED, MDR), path semantics
